findings.summary: yaml.dump rewrites tspconfig.yaml unconditionally even when the inner guard (line 423) is false and no api-version mutation occurred; the file is reformatted (comments stripped) but the api-version override is silently not applied, with no warning logged
findings.failure_scenario: Input data contains apiVersion='2023-01-01' but tspconfig.yaml has no @azure-tools/typespec-python key under options. The file is rewritten by yaml.dump (losing all comments and reformatting), but the api-version is never set. The code generator runs with the wrong (default) api-version, and no warning tells the operator the override was silently dropped.

findings.summary: yaml.safe_load returns None for empty or comment-only YAML files; subsequent content.get('options', {}) at line 423 raises AttributeError on NoneType, crashing gen_typespec with a misleading failure message
findings.failure_scenario: A tspconfig.yaml file exists but is empty (0 bytes) or contains only comments (e.g., '# WIP'). yaml.safe_load returns None. Line 423 calls content.get('options', {}) on None, raising AttributeError. The error propagates to the caller's except Exception handler, which logs 'fail to generate sdk' even though code generation never started.
